segments.t: In the dining room, a suspicious Max quizzes Sasha about Ilya and learns that the returning waiter is her ex-boyfriend from six months ago. While Sasha reassures Max that she is with him now, Ilya waits patiently to speak with Nagiyev about returning to work.
Да это не важно, ты мой бывший.
Через неделю мы поговорим с Сашей.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'So, who is this Ilya?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'come on' before landing on 'Ilya'.
'Senya, go away, will you.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'Senya' and 'go away' in a few short words. Senya answers right away.
Да это не важно, ты мой бывший.
'It does not matter, he is my ex.' The meaning hinges on 'yes' working together with 'former' in spoken Russian.
'And how long ago did you break up?' The meaning hinges on 'both' working together with 'broke up' in spoken Russian.
'Six months ago.' Sasha anchors the line on 'half a year', while 'back' completes the thought. Senya answers right away.
'Oh, no, no, thank you.' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'thank you' without extra filler words.
Через неделю мы поговорим с Сашей.
'In a week I will have a talk with Sasha.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'for a week' before landing on 'Sasha'.
'Ah, speak of the devil.' The grammar packs 'and' and 'he' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Senya answers right away.
'Dmitry Vladimirovich is busy right now.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Dmitry' and finishing on 'busy'.
'Please wait for him right here.' Max brings out the contrast between 'wait' and 'him' in a few short words.
'And what happens now?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'both' and finishing on 'now'. Senya answers right away.
'Wait, are you jealous?' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'are jealous' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I am with you now.' Max anchors the line on 'I', while 'you' completes the thought. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.

Через неделю мы поговорим с Сашей.
